newsitem.title: USA: Sears sees Dec sales in high single digits.
newsitem.headline: Sears sees Dec sales in high single digits.

text.p: Sears, Roebuck and Co's growth in total and same store sales so far in December is in the upper single digits, senior vice president of marketing John Costello said on Thursday.
"We've had solid performance across the store that could produce sales gains in the upper single digits," Costello said, adding that same-store sales will be similar to that.
"Overall sales were strong the last three days before Christmas," he said.
Costello could not give a specific range for the same-store sales figure.
Apparel, tools, jewelry, multimedia computers and the tire departments at Sears performed well, Costello said.
No one region was particularly stronger than the others in sales, except new store openings helping in the U.S. southwestern region's performance, Costello said.
Costello had said earlier this month that he expected the holiday season to set a sales record.
Sears is starting post holidays sales that should continue to generate store traffic, especially as people use their gift certificates and money received as gifts, Costello said.
Sales of gift certificates are already recorded as revenues, but Costello said a fair amount of recipients will use extra cash to supplement their gift certificates for purchases.
Sears had reported a 7.9 percent increase in comparable store sales in 1995, despite a weak holiday season for the retailing industry.
On January 9, the company will release total December sales results, and fourth quarter earnings will be issued in early February, Costello said.
